name: Troy Gapczynski
bio: Troy Gapczynski leads Wahoo Bay's digital storytelling as the organization's social media guru, using creativity and strategy to bring conservation to life online. As the founder of Driven Exposure Media, Troy brings his expertise in digital media and communications to blend visual storytelling, community engagement, and environmental awareness—highlighting the people, programs, and partnerships that make Wahoo Bay thrive. His work helps connect audiences across South Florida and beyond to the mission of community conservation through art, science, and education.
